failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Is the horror film R-Point (2004) set in Kenya or Vietnam? Does R-Point have any scenes or narrative elements set in Kenya, or is the film's entire setting exclusively in Vietnam during the Vietnam War?' and Hop 3 query: 'Is R-Point (2004 Korean horror film) set in Kenya or Vietnam? Was R-Point ever filmed in Kenya, or is it exclusively set and/or filmed in Vietnam and Cambodia? Could the claim be confusing R-Point with a different horror film set in Kenya?' Both queries are formulated as natural-language yes/no questions rather than entity-focused retrieval queries.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query hop 2: 'Is the horror film R-Point (2004) set in Kenya or Vietnam? Does R-Point have any scenes or narrative elements set in Kenya...' Query hop 3: 'Is R-Point (2004 Korean horror film) set in Kenya or Vietnam? Was R-Point ever filmed in Kenya...' Both queries ask essentially the same question about whether R-Point is set in Kenya vs. Vietnam, with near-identical wording and no substantive advancement despite summary_2 already confirming the Kenya claim is contradicted.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_2 reasoning section analyzes: 'Passage [1] explicitly states "Set in 1972 Vietnam, during the Vietnam War" - this directly contradicts the claim's assertion that R-Point is set in Kenya... **Conclusion:** The claim contains a critical factual error regarding the primary narrative setting (Kenya vs. Vietnam)' — the solver extensively re-analyzes the same R-Point passage already processed in hop 1, restating the Vietnam vs. Kenya contradiction rather than identifying what new information hop 2's retrieval provided.

failure_modes.name: Verdict_Despite_Insufficiency
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 states: 'Missing information needed: Clarification on why the claim identifies the setting as Kenya when all available evidence indicates the film is set in Vietnam. Whether there is any secondary or alternate setting in Kenya not mentioned in the passages would require additional sources beyond those provided.' Yet immediately before this, summary_1 declares 'Verification Status: CLAIM IS LARGELY CONTRADICTED' — rendering a definitive verdict while acknowledging clarification is still needed.
